style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontColor=#8c8f98;fontSize=11;fontFamily=IBM Plex Sans;spacing=0;" value="Docker caps each node container and the kubelet reservation makes allocatable match, so the scheduler cannot overcommit a node. CPU is a CFS quota, not core isolation. An OOM kill shows as exit code 137 and not reason OOMKilled, so detect it by exit code plus node events. Profiles: minimal is infra, dev is infra, control and workers, full adds obs, ci is dev driven by tilt ci. Presets change only the numbers. Compile and aggregate pods run one task each with limits equal to requests, so the pod limit is the per-task limit. The compile pool reaches a package index or an optional mirror (on in the ci preset), and the aggregate pool needs no package egress." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="84" width="840" x="20" y="1010" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Docker caps each node container and the kubelet reservation makes allocatable match, so the scheduler cannot overcommit a node. CPU is a CFS quota, not core isolation. An OOM kill shows as exit code 137 and not reason OOMKilled, so detect it by exit code plus node events. Profiles: minimal is infra, dev is infra, control and workers, full adds obs, ci is dev driven by tilt ci. Presets change only the numbers. Compile and aggregate pods run one task each with limits equal to requests, so the pod limit is the per-task limit. The compile pool reaches a package index or an optional mirror (on in the ci preset), and the aggregate pool needs no package egress.
